# lumos_workflows (Data Source)

Workflows DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lumos_workflows" "my_workflows" {
  app_id     = "...my_app_id..."
  page_size  = 100
  page_token = "...my_page_token..."
  type       = "...my_type..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) Filter by app UUID.
- `page_size` (Number) Maximum number of items to return per page. Values above 1000 are clamped to 1000 rather than rejected.
- `page_token` (String) Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page_token`. Omit to fetch the first page. Treat as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.
- `type` (String) Filter by workflow type.

### Read-Only

- `next_page_token` (String) Token for the next page, or null when this is the last page. An absent token is the only end-of-results signal. A page holding fewer than `page_size` items does not mean the results are exhausted. Treat the value as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.
- `workflows` (Attributes List) Workflows returned in this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workflows))

<a id="nestedatt--workflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workflows`

Read-Only:

- `app_id` (String) UUID of the app this Workflow belongs to, if associated.
- `description` (String) A description of this Workflow.
- `id` (String) A UUID identifying this Workflow.
- `name` (String) A name for this Workflow.
- `steps` (Attributes List) The ordered steps of the workflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workflows--steps))
- `type` (String) The kind of workflow.

<a id="nestedatt--workflows--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workflows.steps`

Read-Only:

- `inputs` (Attributes) The configured inputs for this step. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workflows--steps--inputs))
- `name` (String) Server-derived human-readable name for this step. Read-only.
- `step` (String) Identifier (catalogue slug) for the step to execute.
